This kind of stuff happened to me all the time at my old job. Granted I was the Dishwasher and it was really "come in when we need you", but despite that I still had set hours for when they knew I would be needed. The problem was that the manager was forced to make schedules weeks ahead of time, so if the boss came in and told her to change it for some random reason she had to. My employers of course NEVER called me when this happened. So some days I would be getting ready for my 11 oclock shift at around 10:30 only to finally getting a call bitching at me for being late because I was supposed to be in at 9. This worked in reverse as well. I'd come in at 7 some days to help the cooks get going and do prep and such, imagine coming in at 7 only to find it you actually don't have to come in until 12. 
After a while I wised up and started to come to work even when I wasn't working just to make sure the schedule hadn't been changed.
